args.title: Tamarack Components: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Tamarack Components' latest newsletter covers "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and a subscriber-only companion piece with full charts.
• Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
